name: 10and2
description: The connector for 10 & 2: lets you talk to the coding agents on your computer (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, T3 Code) from the 10 & 2 iPhone app.
author: Self-Deprecated ApS

scripts.precheck: bun -e "if (Bun.semver.order(Bun.version, '1.4.3') < 0) { console.error('needs Bun 1.4.3 or later, not ' + Bun.version + ': one before it has no bun check, so this check would run itself forever'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.check: bun check --no-script && bun test --timeout=120000 --parallel=8 ./test/*.test.ts && bun run build && node test/smoke.mjs
scripts.check:node: tsc --noEmit && node --test --test-concurrency=8 --test-timeout=120000 --test-force-exit test/*.test.ts && npm run build && node test/smoke.mjs
